summary: Bench sheets for the Auvrelquith AU-08 oral solution work package (DL_2016_0027). The vehicle ladder covers eight candidate vehicles at 10 mg/mL, the pH and excipient checks show which recipes resisted precipitation on dilution, and the recipe card records the buffer-adjusted solution Auvrelquith took forward for exposure work.
